items.q: Rod played fast like Rex. Rex at that time was one of the fastest trumpet players.

ctx.x: Rod played fast like Rex. Rex at that time was one of the fastest trumpet players. And Rod sounded a whole lot like Rex only Rod had his own original stuff you know. But he --

Cause you know -- he always -- he usually says he wasn't really listening to Louis then yet. It wasn't until a little after that that he come along with Louis and got a -- sort of got a story as well as his speed.
